desc:
A store health report with next steps tells you in plain language how your store is doing and what to do about it. Ecom Swift LLC checks the basics, fixes the small issues, and hands you a short report with a status for every area.

## What is a store health report?

A store health report is a short document that sums up the technical condition of your store. It covers speed, broken links, theme and app status, search errors, checkout and basic security. Each area gets a simple status, a note on what we found and a recommendation. It is written for a store owner, not for a developer, so you can read it in a few minutes and act on it.

## Why a regular health check is worth having

Most owners see their store from the front door. They look at the home page, add a product, and think everything works. Problems often sit behind that view: an app that slows every page, a run of search errors, a link that fails, an old admin account that is still active.

Because these issues grow slowly, they rarely feel urgent. A check gives them a name and a priority. It also gives you a record, so when something changes you can see when and why.

## How a report helps you decide

The value of a report is better decisions. Instead of reacting to the last complaint, you see which areas need attention first and what each fix is likely to involve. That keeps spending focused on problems that matter, not on whatever feels loudest.

A clear report also saves time with other people. You can pass it to a developer, a marketer or a business partner, and everyone starts from the same facts. We also separate what we fixed from what we advise, so you always know what changed in your store.

## What a useful health report includes

- Page speed on key pages, on phone and desktop.
- Broken links and redirect problems.
- Theme and app status, including anything out of date.
- Search errors reported by Google Search Console, where available.
- A checkout check to confirm orders can be placed.
- Basic security signals, such as staff accounts and two-step login.
- A traffic and sales summary taken from your analytics, in the larger packages.
- A status mark for each area, in plain words.
- A list of what we fixed during the check.
- Recommended next steps, ranked, with the cost of each.

## What we do

We begin by reviewing your store, your analytics and your search tools, using access you give us as a collaborator or staff user. We run the checks area by area and keep notes and screenshots as we go.

When we find a small issue that is safe to correct, such as a broken menu link or an oversized image, we fix it and record it. Larger issues we leave alone and explain, so you decide whether to go ahead. Then we write the report. Basic gives you a one page summary of the main basics. Standard widens the checks, adds analytics numbers and includes screenshots. Premium covers more areas, compares trends against your previous quarter, ranks a priority plan with costs and finishes with a short review call. Regular monthly reports can be quoted after this first one.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Read the report with your goals in mind, and tell us what matters most.
- Share your analytics and search tool access so we can check real data.
- Treat the priority list as a plan, and pick the top few items.
- Keep each report, so you can compare one with the next.
- Ask us what any term means if the wording is unclear.

**Avoid:**
- Judging store health from the home page alone.
- Waiting for a visible failure before you check the basics.
- Fixing every item at once, which makes results hard to trace.
- Ignoring items marked as watch, since they often grow.
- Sharing the report with anyone who does not need your store details.

## Who this is for

This suits owners who want a clear picture of the store without learning technical tools. It suits businesses that have not had a technical review since launch. It also suits anyone about to hire a developer or agency who wants an independent starting point.

## What we need from you

Your store address, access as a collaborator or staff user, and read access to analytics and Search Console if you use them. We do not need passwords. Tell us your main goal, such as more orders or a faster store, so we can order the advice around it.
